stotram_meaning: In Madurai reigns Meenakshi, whose compassionate fish-shaped eyes ceaselessly protect and nourish all living beings in creation.
dhyana_shloka: श्यामलाङ्गीं शशाङ्कार्धशेखरां मञ्जुभाषिणीम् । मातुलुङ्गं च दर्पणं च बिभ्रतीं नौमि मीनाक्षीम् ॥
dhyana_meaning: I praise Meenakshi of lovely dark-emerald hue, adorned with crescent moon, sweet of speech, holding the mirror and sacred fruit in Her gentle hands.
aarti_first_line: कर्पूरारति सुप्रिया मीनाक्षी जगदीश्वरी पाहि माम् ।
common_prayer: सर्वमङ्गलकारिणी मातर्मधुरापुरनायिके । मीनाक्षि देवि करुणां कुरु मे दयाब्धे ॥
